item.title: Paramore - This Is Why - Bittersweet Press
item.description: It’s been 5 long years since Paramore’s last release - and This Is Why. A product of cabin feverish introspection, This Is Why places the Paramore psyche under a microscope; combining indie-rock grooves, post-punk melodrama and the gorgeous honesty of Hayley Williams’ solo endeavours, this record slowly unravels what it is to be alive. item.title: Pierce the Veil - The Jaws of Life - Bittersweet Press
item.description: Eight years on from their last release, Pierce the Veil make their absence - and their grand return - felt on The Jaws of Life.

item.title: DRAIN - FTS (KYS) - Bittersweet Press
item.description: Sometimes all you need is a roar of raw, thrashing hardcore to take the edge off - thankfully, DRAIN have got us covered. Latest single FTS (KYS) serves up blistering optimism and exposed-nerve breakdowns, an onslaught of posi-vibes to soundtrack the moment you’re given a nasty nosebleed and knocked out cold in the pit.

item.title: Slam Dunk's Worst Clashes go head to head... - Bittersweet Press
item.description: Slam Dunk is back with it's best lineup ever. Ahead of the big day, we’re rounding up the most difficult clashes so you can start worrying about who to choose...

item.title: LØLØ - omg - Bittersweet Press
item.description: Hopeless Records's latest pop-punk prodigy LØLØ is back with a banger, the latest in the line of singles that followed 2022's stunner of a debut EP debbie downer, which was laden with catharsis-inducing, scream-along pop-punk perfection. omg follows the same blueprint, with intimate stripped-back verses punctuated by bold riffs and pure energy.

item.title: DRAIN - LIVING PROOF - Bittersweet Press
item.description: There’s clearly something special laced in that Californian air, and DRAIN are living proof of it. Bold, brash and violently passionate, LIVING PROOF is here to scratch your hardcore itch and then some.

item.title: Bittersweet's Pride Picks - Bittersweet Press
